import re
import pytest
from target import url_basename

def old_url_basename(url):
    """Reference implementation using the original regex."""
    m = re.match(r'(?:https?:|)//[^/]+/(?:[^?#]+/)?([^/?#]+)/?(?:[?#]|$)', url)
    if not m:
        return u''
    return m.group(1)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url",
    [
        "http://example.com/foo",
        "https://example.com/foo/",
        "//example.com/bar/baz",
        "http://example.com/a/b/c?x=1",
        "http://example.com/foo?bar",
        "http://example.com/foo#section",
        "http://example.com/foo/?bar",
        "http://example.com",
        "not a url",
        "http://example.com/.hidden",
        "https://sub.domain.co.uk/path/to/resource/",
        "https://sub.domain.co.uk/path/to/resource?query=param",
        "https://sub.domain.co.uk/path/to/resource#frag",
        "https://sub.domain.co.uk/path/to/resource/?query=param",
        "ftp://example.com/unsupported",  # scheme not http/https but pattern still matches after //
        "http://example.com/mixed?query#frag",
        "http://example.com/mixed/#frag",
        "http://example.com/mixed//double",  # double slash in path
        "http://example.com/endslash/",
        "http://example.com/endslash",
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_behaviour_matches_old(url):
    assert url_basename(url) == old_url_basename(url)
